form:FormGroup.label: File Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: Format of the report file: Excel (.xlsx), CSV, TSV or Markdown. Default is Excel.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Excel, CSV, TSV or Markdown. Default is Excel.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Send the report even when the query finds no data, so recipients know it ran. If unticked, a report with no rows is not sent.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: If unticked, reports with no rows are not sent.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Ask an AI model to summarise the report's data and send the summary with it: as a sheet in Excel, a section in Markdown, or a separate file for CSV and TSV. Email templates can use it as {{{{ aiSummary }}. If the model cannot be reached the report is sent without a summary.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Adds an AI summary. The report is still sent if this fails.

form:FormGroup.label: AI Summary Model
form:FormGroup.helpText: The model to ask. If this is not set the model configured for Ask Stroom AI is used.

form:FormGroup.label: AI Summary Prompt
form:FormGroup.helpText: What to ask the model about the report's data. Leave this empty to use the default, which asks for a short summary of what the data shows and anything worth attention.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Leave blank to use the default summary prompt.

form:FormGroup.label: Feed For Errors
form:FormGroup.helpText: Feed that errors from running this report are written to. If the report has none, the default error feed for reports is shown and used. A schedule cannot be enabled without an error feed. Administrators can select Set Default to make this feed the default for all reports.
